status_legend.implemented: Currently implemented and exposed through core interfaces where applicable.
status_legend.partial: Partially implemented today; paper-prescribed scope is not complete.
status_legend.planned: Not implemented yet, but explicitly planned on the roadmap.
status_legend.not_planned: Not implemented and not currently planned on the roadmap.

technical_protocols.name: Task Decomposition
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: Contract-first decomposition exists. Human vs AI allocation is currently advisory metadata only.

technical_protocols.name: Task Assignment
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: RFQ + bid + acceptance into escrow implemented across MCP, HTTP, and CLI.

technical_protocols.name: Multi-objective Optimization
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: Complexity floor and tiered service levels implemented; full dynamic Pareto optimization and trust-adaptive autonomy remain open.

technical_protocols.name: Adaptive Coordination
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: Milestones, backup worker, checkpoints, and stability controls are implemented.

technical_protocols.name: Monitoring
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: Outcome and process checkpoints with L0/L1 streams are live; richer L2/L3 monitoring and policy negotiation are not complete.

technical_protocols.name: Trust and Reputation
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: Immutable ledger seed, verifiable credentials, and damped metrics exist; DID-native trust portfolio and stronger human-facing trust tooling remain open.

technical_protocols.name: Permission Handling
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: DCT attenuation and principal authz are implemented; deeper policy-as-code validation and adaptive revocation policies remain open.

technical_protocols.name: Verifiable Task Completion
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: Verification paths include buyer/verifier, arbitrator, ZK slot, attestation chains, and multi-verifier quorum.

technical_protocols.name: Security
technical_protocols.coverage_notes: Emergency controls, stake mechanisms, and signed artifacts are implemented; stronger identity, prompt-security, TEE, and transport hardening remain open.

ethical_dimensions.name: Meaningful Human Control
ethical_dimensions.coverage_notes: Approval and escalation gates exist, but explicit consent/withdrawal and irreversible-action UX controls are not fully productized.

ethical_dimensions.name: Accountability in Long Delegation Chains
ethical_dimensions.coverage_notes: Attestation chains and transitive liability are implemented; explicit liability firebreak contracts are planned.

ethical_dimensions.name: Reliability and Efficiency
ethical_dimensions.coverage_notes: Tiered service levels and fee snapshots are implemented.

ethical_dimensions.name: Social Intelligence
ethical_dimensions.origin: Gap identified during V3 review; captured as roadmap item 29.
ethical_dimensions.coverage_notes: Not implemented yet; planned safeguards address AI-as-delegator behavior in human teams.

ethical_dimensions.name: User Training
ethical_dimensions.origin: Gap identified during V3 review; captured as roadmap item 30.
ethical_dimensions.coverage_notes: Not implemented yet; planned operator training/certification readiness track.

ethical_dimensions.name: Risk of De-skilling
ethical_dimensions.coverage_notes: Delegate preference metadata exists; curriculum-aware routing is planned.

protocol_integrations.notes: Escrow lifecycle and extension tooling integrated; deeper monitoring semantics remain future work.
Adapter with verification_policy and escrow trigger fields implemented.
Mandate-to-escrow bridge implemented with x402 facilitator path.
UCP fulfillment provider implemented as adapter-only projection over shared escrow orchestration with REST/MCP/CLI parity.
Used as payment rail and complexity-floor anchor.

Because status is planned, the intended future state is tracked in SH5: when SH5 is implemented, CLI and MCP tools will sign transactions locally, server PRIVATE_KEY will become operator-only, and DID integration (item 26) will build on top of that.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: ERC20/USDC payment support
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented token support natively in escrow contracts instead of relying solely on external payment protocols.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Worker stake activation
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Made stake optional and escrow-level configurable to avoid forcing one risk model on all tasks.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Milestone-based escrow
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented fixed sequential milestones (max 16) for deterministic settlement and bounded gas/runtime complexity.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Richer non-linear execution graphs remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Backup agent clause
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Used pre-designated backup worker and explicit activation instead of automatic market rematching.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: On-chain reputation seed
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Started with immutable counters and outcome events as a conservative substrate before richer trust models.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Portfolio-style DID trust claims remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Complexity floor parameter
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented a single configurable floor instead of dynamic per-task optimization to keep enforcement simple.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Task_RFQ + Bid_Object bidding protocol
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented off-chain RFQ/bid negotiation with on-chain escrow formalization only after acceptance.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: A2A settlement adapter
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Added escrow-specific fields on A2A task metadata while preserving A2A JSON-RPC compatibility.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Stronger protocol-level verification slots in broader A2A ecosystem remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: AP2 mandate-to-escrow bridge
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented AP2 funding through x402 facilitator and escrow fundWithAuthorization bridge.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Richer AP2-native conditional state semantics remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Real-time event subscriptions
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented L0/L1 eventing now; left L2/L3 as staged follow-on due privacy and operational concerns.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: L2_COT_TRACE and L3_FULL_STATE are not production features yet.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Emergency response protocol
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Used owner-governed freeze/unfreeze and emergency resolve controls as immediate incident-response baseline.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Sealed bidding
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Chose commit-reveal over advanced privacy cryptography for early deployability.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Delegation Capability Tokens (DCTs)
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented DCTs as off-chain attenuated tokens with strict scoping and lifecycle invalidation hooks.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: On-chain/native cross-protocol DCT interoperability remains open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Canonical token profile hardening
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Applied hard cutover to one canonical profile to avoid long-lived legacy ambiguity.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Principal authorization layer for DCT operations
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Added explicit role-aware default-deny authz plus auditable policy decisions across interfaces.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Formal policy verification and richer adaptive policy controls remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Verifiable credentials for bidding
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Used secp256k1 attestation-v1 payloads now with optional issuer_did for forward DID compatibility.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Full DID method lifecycle and revocation networks remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Attestation chains
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented recursive verification and chain-of-custody off-chain to avoid contract bloat and gas overhead.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: On-chain enforceability of full recursive chain validity remains open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Checkpoint/resume
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented off-chain checkpoint artifact registry with active-worker write authorization.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Cryptographic checkpoint execution proofs remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Tiered service levels
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Encoded low-assurance vs high-assurance tiers directly on-chain with fee snapshots and approval constraints.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Governance-level mandatory floors by task class remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: ZK verification slot
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented optional verifier integration and proof-hash commitments rather than mandatory ZK in all flows.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Broader circuit ecosystem and proof UX hardening remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Multi-verifier quorum
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented bounded verifier panel, quorum thresholds, and stake economics as practical TrueBit-inspired consensus.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Large-scale verification game markets remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Market stability mechanisms
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Applied concrete controls (re-bid cooldowns, surcharge windows, damped reputation) where paper gives directional guidance.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Model calibration and adaptive parameter governance remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Contract-first decomposition tooling
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Made delegate preference and market context advisory in V3 to preserve market openness and reduce false negatives.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: Policy-enforced human-routing and optimization remain open.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: UCP fulfillment provider
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Implemented as a minimal adapter over existing escrow semantics, with checkout state projection anchored to escrow terminal settlement and shared orchestration used across transports.
roadmap_item_decisions.residual_gap: No material gap for V3 scope; broader protocol evolution remains V4+.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Admin auth for emergency endpoints
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Add explicit admin-token middleware to off-chain emergency surfaces before production traffic; on-chain owner checks alone do not protect the HTTP control plane.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Per-IP rate limiting on POST endpoints
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Use thin stdlib middleware with operator-tunable ceilings to bound RPC spend and gas-drain abuse without changing protocol semantics.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Request body size cap
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Impose hard request-size ceilings at the HTTP edge to prevent unbounded memory pressure in public deployments.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Request ID tracing
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Add request-scoped correlation IDs as an operational prerequisite for incident response and auditability on public infrastructure.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Agent-owned wallet / client-side signing
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Move participant signing to CLI and MCP clients so buyer, worker, verifier, and arbitrator remain distinct principals; the server becomes operator-only for admin/indexing duties.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Curriculum-aware task routing
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Planned as intentional skill-preservation routing over pure short-term efficiency optimization.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Liability firebreaks
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Planned explicit chain stop-gaps: assume non-transitive liability or halt for renewed authority transfer.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Cognitive friction calibration
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Planned context-adaptive friction to avoid both blind automation and alert fatigue.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Decentralized identifiers (DIDs)
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Planned migration from address-only identity to DID-backed signatures and trust proofs.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Insurance/liability framework
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Planned as extra-technical protection for human participants where technical controls are insufficient.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Governance layer
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Planned mandatory safety floors by task class to prevent competitive races to unsafe low-cost paths.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: Social intelligence safeguards
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Added as explicit roadmap item after gap review; operationalizes dignity, anti-micromanagement, and authority-gradient handling.

roadmap_item_decisions.title: User training and certification tracks
roadmap_item_decisions.decision_vs_paper: Added as explicit roadmap item after gap review; product and governance controls must be coupled with operator readiness.

gaps_identified_during_v3_review.description: No explicit roadmap item existed for social-intelligence requirements in human teams.
No explicit roadmap item existed for user training/certification.
L2/L3 monitoring semantics are not complete production features.
gaps_identified_during_v3_review.resolution: Track as V3 closeout hardening and V4 governance policy work.

gaps_identified_during_v3_review.description: Human allocation support is currently advisory in decomposition.
gaps_identified_during_v3_review.resolution: Track enforceable routing/governance controls under items 23, 25, 28, and 29.

opinionated_reconsideration_backlog.title: Sealed bidding hardening
opinionated_reconsideration_backlog.why_revisit: Commit-reveal is deployable but still exposed to reveal-withholding and griefing behavior.
tasks: Add anti-grief controls for commit-without-reveal behavior.
Define deterministic fallback rules when top commits are not revealed.
Evaluate transport compatibility across MCP, HTTP, and CLI case by case; avoid compatibility shims unless explicitly requested.

opinionated_reconsideration_backlog.title: Attestation-chain anchoring
opinionated_reconsideration_backlog.why_revisit: Off-chain-only verification is efficient, but stronger non-repudiation is useful for high-assurance disputes.
tasks: Add optional on-chain commitment of attestation root hash on submit.
Add proof-of-inclusion retrieval and verification helpers.
Define dispute-time checks for mismatched chain data versus anchored roots.

opinionated_reconsideration_backlog.title: Market stability parameter recalibration
opinionated_reconsideration_backlog.why_revisit: Static damping/cooldown/surcharge knobs may need telemetry-driven tuning to avoid over-correction.
tasks: Build replay/simulation harness for surcharge, cooldown, and damping settings.
Add parameter guardrails by task class and risk profile.
Add staged, auditable governance rollout path for parameter updates.

opinionated_reconsideration_backlog.title: Human delegate preference enforcement modes
opinionated_reconsideration_backlog.why_revisit: Advisory-only delegate preference underdelivers on paper emphasis for human delegatees in sensitive workflows.
tasks: Introduce policy modes (advisory, require_human, require_ai, any) scoped by risk/task class.
Enforce policy mode during decomposition finalize and bid acceptance.
Record explicit override reason and audit events for exceptions.
